title: Lantern retrieval decision
text: Project Lantern decision: we will use SQLite FTS5 for retrieval first and only add a vector index after an evaluation shows it helps.

title: Desk lamp colour
text: The desk lamp is set to 2700K in the evening and 4000K while working. Hue bulb, controlled through the bridge.

title: Orion planning meeting
text: Orion planning meeting on 12 September. Actions: Neku to send the revised budget sheet by Friday. Priya to book the test lab. Decision: ship the beta in October.

title: Bike lock
text: The bike lock combination is written on the card inside the blue toolbox, second drawer.

title: Argos order confirmation
text: Thanks for your order from Argos. Order 8812-3301: 1 x Russell Hobbs kettle, £29.99. Collect from the Headingley store.

title: Amazon dispatched
text: Your Amazon order 203-5567 has been dispatched: Fifine USB microphone K669. Expected delivery Thursday.

title: Python study plan
text: Python study plan: lists and loops this week, then functions, then files and errors. Thirty minutes each weekday evening at 19:30.

title: Rover computer
text: Decision for the rover: the onboard computer will be a Raspberry Pi 5 with a separate microcontroller for the motor watchdog. Changed from the earlier Pi 4 plan.

title: Weekly shop
text: Weekly shop list: oat milk, Earl Grey tea, basmati rice, tinned tomatoes, kitchen roll.

title: Hydra sync
text: Hydra weekly sync. Marcus asked for the API error budget numbers. Action: Neku to share the dashboard link. No decisions.

title: Camera
text: Front door camera is a Reolink; it exposes RTSP on the LAN. Credentials are in the password manager under 'front door cam'.

title: Boiler service
text: Boiler was serviced on 3 March by Northgate Heating. Next service due March next year. Pressure should sit around 1.2 bar.

title: MTG deck
text: Commander deck 'Tide Turner' is mono-blue, led by Thassa. Mostly instants and flash creatures; avoid cards that need green mana.

title: Audio hardware
text: Decision: use a USB speakerphone with a physical mute button for the desk instead of a microphone HAT, so the mute is a real hardware cut.

title: Amazon refund
text: Refund issued for Amazon order 203-1190 (HDMI cable). £8.49 returned to your card within 5 days.

title: Wi-Fi
text: The study Wi-Fi access point is on channel 36; the mesh node in the hall drops out when the microwave runs.

title: Orion retro
text: Orion retrospective. What went well: test coverage. What didn't: late design changes. Action: Priya to write the design freeze policy.

title: Doctor
text: GP appointment booked for 21 October at 10:40, Burley Park surgery. Bring the blood test letter.

title: Govee strip
text: The Govee strip behind the monitor is model H6159; LAN control is enabled in the Govee app so Home Assistant can reach it locally.

title: Backups
text: Vault backups go to the external HDD every night at 02:00; keep fourteen days. Test a restore on the first of each month.

title: Python lesson 2
text: Lesson 2 covered for loops over lists and range(). Exercise: sum the even numbers under 100. Got it right on the second attempt after an off-by-one.

title: Car MOT
text: Car MOT is due 14 November. Garage on Kirkstall Road; book two weeks ahead.

title: Delivery attempted
text: Evri tried to deliver parcel H00234 today; no one answered. It will be left at the Co-op parcel shop tomorrow.

title: Timezone
text: All reminders are scheduled in Europe/London; the scheduler must handle the clocks changing in March and October.

title: Plants
text: Water the monstera every ten days and the basil daily in summer. The fern wants misting.
